title: Remove misleading HOLD protection attribution in prospective Compass outcome proxy
objective: At pinned baa8c30da6285066f3b25ff13d42c1dc1104441c action_quality('HOLD', -2.0, -3.0) reports PROTECTIVE, although the existing action retains market exposure. Use existing abstention semantics for HOLD until an authorized capital-state comparator exists. Preserve historical outcome files and frozen forecasts. This is correction of measurement attribution, not an action-policy change or a new economic model.

evidence.summary: action_quality groups HOLD with WAIT and HARD_WAIT at lines 203-215
23 immutable outcomes label HOLD protective, all on 12h; 15 v2, 8 v1. No portfolio execution evidence.

reproduction: From exact pinned commit run: python -c "from scripts.learning.compass_outcomes import action_quality; print(action_quality('HOLD', -2.0, -3.0))". Current result PROTECTIVE is reproduced. Run the accompanying read-only replay_compass.py against the pinned checkout to locate all 23 historical cases. Fresh-read sole queue and target code before readiness; stop/NOOP if already repaired or duplicate. PREPARE is a separate permission-attribution question and is not part of this fix.

positive: HOLD with negative, zero and positive return must never report PROTECTIVE or imply avoided drawdown. Use an existing unscored/abstained result with exposure-specific note, no new decision class.
Verify newly matured synthetic HOLD outcome has correct return and source hashes, while frozen input bytes and all existing outcome bytes remain unchanged.
negative: WAIT and HARD_WAIT proxy outputs remain unchanged and explicitly PROXY_ONLY; no portfolio PnL is asserted.
DEPLOY, PREPARE, NO_EDGE and missing return retain existing behavior; do not alter policy, triggers, sizing, alert or SELL authority.
Missing/early target remains pending and writes no mature outcome; existing checksum tampering regressions still reject corrupt sources.

post_fix_gate: Independent exact-head review and applicable CI; only normal non-authoring merge. Verify next eligible main-produced HOLD outcome and its unchanged immutable forecast. No RESOLVED until exact merged code plus downstream receipt; absence of new HOLD stays pending.
